_comment: This file is a pure MMSegmentation configuration file (dict assignments only). It defines model settings for OCRNet with HRNet-18 backbone for semantic segmentation. No functions, classes, or callable APIs are present — only configuration variables (norm_cfg, data_preprocessor, model). No example statements can be generated.
summarize_model_config: summarize the OCRNet HRNet-18 model configuration for semantic segmentation with 19 classes
review_model_config: review the CascadeEncoderDecoder model config with FCNHead and OCRHead decode heads
review_backbone_config: review the HRNet backbone configuration with 4 stages and w18 channel widths
review_data_preprocessor: review the SegDataPreProcessor settings with ImageNet mean/std normalization
review_norm_config: review the SyncBN normalization configuration used across model components
